scope: observed command catalogue, not capability or creative acceptance

commands.label: Add Puppet Pin
commands.params: {layer?, kind?: position|advanced|bend|starch|overlap, position: [x,y] (layer space), time? (s) | frame?, mesh?: uid, newMesh?, density?, expansion?, triangles?}

commands.label: Move Puppet Pin
commands.params: {layer?, pin: uid | name, position: [x,y], time? | frame?, merge?}

commands.label: Edit Puppet Pin
commands.params: {layer?, pin: uid | name, position?, scale? (%), rotation? (°), amount? (%), extent? (px), inFront?, time? | frame?, merge?}

commands.label: Delete Puppet Pin
commands.params: {layer?, pin?: uid | name, pins?: [uid | name…]} (default: the selected pins)

commands.label: Puppet Mesh Options
commands.params: {layer?, mesh?: uid, density?, expansion?, triangles?, showMesh?, time?, merge?}

commands.label: Record Puppet Pin
commands.params: {layer?, pin: uid | name, samples: [[t, x, y]…] (t = seconds since the drag began, layer space), pins?: [uid | name…] (more pins that move by the same displacement), start? (s, default current time), speed? (%, Record Options), smoothing? (Record Options)}

commands.label: Follow-Through...
commands.params: {layer?, leader?: uid | name (default: the first selected pin), pins?: [uid | name…] (default: the other selected pins), delay? (s, 0.1), amount? (%, 100), cascade? (true: the k-th nearest pin trails k × delay)}
